claims.title: An entropy-deficit criterion is proposed for sharp counting continuity with exact kernel marginals

status: source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. Intake checked byte preservation and repository structure; no independent proof reconstruction, scientific-code replay, citation verification, formal proof, quantum circuit execution, or experimental validation was performed. interface: Let H=(V,E) be a finite simple graph with n vertices and m>=1 edges, p>1 and B>1. Kernels W:[0,1]^2->[0,infinity) are nonnegative, symmetric, have row integral exactly one almost everywhere and ||W||_p<=B. The observable is t(H,W)=integral product_{uv in E} W(x_u,x_v); discrepancy is the usual cut norm, not merely pairwise pointwise or operator approximation.
limits: Recover the exact cited singleton-conditioned normal-polymatroid theorem and diagnostic artifacts; independently reconstruct dyadic tails, realization, zero-scale edges, marginal completion and the hypergraph discrepancy interface. Strong-Lp continuity at gamma=1 and a polynomial-size replacement for the exponential criterion remain unresolved.
